乱了，全乱了。

林舒的答案说出口之后，秦朗也坐不住了。

在最初的判断里，自己认为厉雨应该是跟徐长顺、林舒一拨的----就算不是朋友，那起码也得是有共同利益、或者面对共同威胁的盟友。

但现在，林舒说出的答案与自己小组前期的判断完全相悖。

厉雨回去找昆尸是为了对付林舒？

那不就是说，林舒跟厉雨是敌对的？

既然你跟厉雨是敌对的，那你不就跟我们要找的那些“神秘敌人”是一拨的了吗？

他看着林舒，神情愕然地继续问道：

“你确定他是为了对付你？为什么？”

“.......这是个很长的故事。”

从秦朗的表情里，林舒也意识到了问题有些严重。

坏菜了。

自己跟厉雨的敌对，在秦朗看来似乎有别的意义。

自己必须立刻做出澄清，不然地话......

搞不好我他么就真成嫌疑人了！

想到这里，他立刻开口解释道：

“厉雨接受了委托想要杀我，被我制住了。”

“他大概率是想要借昆尸破局才回到湘西，但最终死在了昆尸手下。”

话音落下，秦朗猛地松了口气。

三角案！

----可惜，眼前这个林舒并不是自己要找的幕后黑手。

不过这样也好。

从目前情况来看，这人的水平不低，是友非敌，总比是敌非友要好......

秦朗重新坐了下来。

“我说你小子说话能不能不要大喘气.......吓我一跳！”

他略微沉吟片刻，仔细梳理整件事情后开口说道：

“那这么说，厉雨的案子实际上只是一个‘支线’。”

“他要杀你但杀不掉，所以才返回湘西，他的死亡其实是一个意外。”

“真正的主线还是在‘杀你’这一件事情上。”

“你知不知道要杀你的人是谁？知不知道他们为什么要杀你？”

林舒摊了摊手。

“我以为你们会知道。”

“你们不是在查徐长顺的事情吗？那些人要杀我的理由，跟他们杀徐长顺的理由应该是一样的吧？”

“理论上是。”

秦朗缓缓点头。

“但又没那么简单。”

略微一顿，他继续说道：

It's chaos, it's all chaos.

After Lin Shu's answer was spoken, Qin Lang couldn't sit still.

In my initial judgment, I thought that Li Yu should be with Xu Changshun and Lin Shu - even if they are not friends, they must at least be allies with common interests or facing common threats.

But now, the answer Lin Shu gave was completely contrary to the earlier judgment of his team.

Did Li Yu go back to find Kun Zhi to deal with Lin Shu?

Doesn't that mean that Lin Shu and Li Yu are hostile?

Since you and Li Yu are hostile, aren't you in the same group as the "mysterious enemies" we are looking for?

He looked at Lin Shu and continued to ask with a stunned expression:

"Are you sure he wanted to deal with you? Why?"

"...It's a long story."

From Qin Lang's expression, Lin Shu also realized that the problem was somewhat serious.

Bad food.

The hostility between himself and Li Yu seems to have other meanings in Qin Lang's opinion.

I must make clarification immediately, otherwise...

Maybe I will become a suspect!

Thinking of this, he immediately explained:

"Li Yu accepted the commission and wanted to kill me, but I restrained him."

"He most likely wanted to use Kun Zhi to break the situation before returning to Xiangxi, but in the end he died at Kun Zhi's hands."

After the words fell, Qin Lang suddenly breathed a sigh of relief.

Triangle case!

----Unfortunately, the Lin Shu in front of him was not the mastermind he was looking for.

But that’s fine too.

Judging from the current situation, this person's level is not low. He is a friend but not an enemy, which is better than being an enemy but not a friend...

Qin Lang sat down again.

"I asked you, kid, can you please stop gasping when you speak... you'll scare me!"

He pondered for a moment, carefully sorted out the whole thing, and then said:

"In that case, Li Yu's case is actually just a 'branch'."

"He wanted to kill you but couldn't, so he returned to Xiangxi. His death was actually an accident."

"The real main line is still the matter of 'killing you'."

"Do you know who the people are who want to kill you? Do you know why they want to kill you?"

Lin Shu spread his hands.

"I thought you would know."

"Aren't you investigating Xu Changshun's affairs? The reason why those people wanted to kill me should be the same as the reason why they killed Xu Changshun, right?"

"Theoretically yes."

Qin Lang nodded slowly.

"But it's not that simple."
